verdict.rationale: Mastra is Apache 2.0 licensed and explicitly documents self-hosting ("Self host your Mastra projects... Free Apache 2.0 licensed $0/month... Build and host agents anywhere") and deployment to any Node.js-compatible environment or runtime (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare) without requiring a vendor platform. Community comments corroborate 'no vendor lock in' sentiment. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a fully offline/self-hosted production deployment, and clarity on whether any optional hosted features (e.g., observability/enterprise controls) require vendor dependency.
